# Hindi PDF Editor

> Hindi-first web editing and Android tools. Core edits run locally; optional AI OCR and translation send approved content for processing. Keep the source and review every export.

## Capabilities and limits

New Hindi text uses Unicode fonts and HTML shaping. The web export starts from the original file: unedited pages are copied unchanged, replaced text is removed from edited pages (or cleaned from scans) while table lines stay, and new words are added as images, so they are not searchable. Any edit invalidates a digital signature. Kruti Dev and DevLys pages are converted to Unicode and checked against the page image; other legacy fonts and unknown encodings block editing. Sign PDF adds a drawn, typed or uploaded signature as an image (an electronic signature, not a certificate-based digital signature) by hand, or on every page or chosen pages at a preset or dragged position, with each page's position adjustable on its own. Fill PDF form types Hindi or English answers into a PDF's own form fields (text, check boxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, list boxes); Hindi answers are drawn by the browser as the field's appearance and the typed text is kept as the field value. PDF to Word reads each page's text in the browser (the PDF's own text, repaired Hindi, or OCR for scans) into an editable .docx with paragraphs, sizes, headings and ruled tables (as Word tables with merged cells, scanned pages included); text drawn as images is read with OCR; pictures (logos, photos, stamps) are placed in reading order; exact positions are not kept. Word to PDF lays out a .docx in the browser and saves page images (text not searchable) or prints to Save as PDF for selectable text. Merge/split copy pages; compression rasterizes pages to JPEG and cannot guarantee a target file size. AI features require consent and enforce quotas. Editing an issued record does not authorize an official correction.
